title: Render receipt
description: Records HOW a canonical concept was rendered for an audience: the stable canonical_id PLUS the rendered_label, alias profile + version, and surface. Storing the canonical_id (not just the label) keeps the audit trail intact if the label is later renamed (docs/standards/presentation-layer.md §17).

canonical_id.description: the STABLE concept id, e.g. stage.anti_fragility

resolution_source.description: which scope won the fallback chain
